title: Bali Beyond Ordinary | A Romantic Getaway
highlights: Embark on a journey through Bali’s diverse wonders, where cliffside temples, scenic coastlines, and cultural gems come together for the ultimate island escape.
Step into the sacred realm of Lempuyang Temple, where the legendary Gates of Heaven frame Mount Agung, offering one of Bali’s most iconic views.
Wander through Tirta Gangga’s royal water gardens, where koi-filled ponds, tiered fountains, and stone statues create a dream-like landscape.
Witness the dramatic Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple, where fire, chants, and cliffside views come alive during Bali’s most spellbinding sunset rituals.
Savor a romantic dinner at Sadara Resort, where a private table by the beach, soft candlelight, and a tailor-made menu create an unforgettable evening under the stars.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a captivating Bali journey that blends adventure, culture, nature, and relaxation. From exploring the tranquil rice terraces of Sidemen and the mystical caves of Goa Gajah to soaking in the cascading charm of Kanto Lampo Waterfall, every day brings a discovery. Ride ATVs through lush jungle trails, swing high above tropical valleys, and snorkel in the crystal-clear waters of Nusa Penida. Witness Bali’s spiritual essence at Tirta Gangga and Lempuyang Temple, and unwind with a traditional Balinese massage. Conclude your days with unforgettable sunsets, from scenic viewpoints to cliffside temples, and a magical Kecak dance under the stars. This tour captures the essence of Bali—raw, serene, and soul-stirring.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Sidemen | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to your hotel in Sideman. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can take a scenic walk to Gembleng Waterfall, a hidden gem with tiered rock pools offering natural infinity-style dips and jungle views. Also, you can visit Pande Silver Sidemen, where skilled artisans guide you through a hands-on silver jewelry-making workshop, or indulge in traditional therapies at Ananda Spa and Bathhouse.

items.title: Silver Class & Workshop Pande Silver Sidemen
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: East Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to explore the scenic highlights of East Bali. Explore Tirta Gangga, a former royal water palace featuring elegant fountains, koi-filled pools, and intricate sculptures. Visit the stunning Lempuyang Temple, home to the famed “Gates of Heaven”, where you can capture amazing views of Mount Agung. Also, enjoy spending time at the serene Bukit Cinta Viewpoint, a hidden gem where sweeping rice terraces and volcanic backdrops create the perfect photo stop.

days.title: ATV Ride & Bali Swing Experience
days.desc: Set out for an adventurous day amidst Bali’s lush landscapes. Kick off the excitement with a thrilling Jungle ATV ride, as you navigate muddy trails, rocky paths, and lush forest tracks, an exhilarating way to experience Bali’s untamed beauty. Next, get driven to experience the iconic Bali Swing, where you can soar high above jungle canopies and rice fields, capturing stunning views and unforgettable photo moments. After an amazing day, get driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: ATV Adventure in Bali - ATV Ride +  Bali Swing Experience

days.title: Visit Sidemen Rice Terrace, Kanto Lampo Waterfall & Goa Gajah | Transfer to Seminyak | Candlelight Dinner Experience
days.desc: Post checkout, get driven to Seminyak, Bali’s coastal town. En route, explore the Sidemen Rice Terrace, offering a glimpse into Bali’s timeless agricultural traditions. Also, visit the Kanto Lampo Waterfall, a hidden gem perfect for capturing that Instagram-worthy shot & marvel at the mythical figures carved at Goa Gajah, the ancient ‘Elephant Cave’ temple. Upon arrival in Seminyak, check into your hotel & relax. Later, get driven to Sadara restaurant & indulge in a romantic candlelight dinner.

days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour with Snorkeling Experience
days.desc: Begin your day by getting driven to Sanur Port & board a speedboat to Nusa Penida for a tour of its west coast. Explore Kelingking Beach, famous for its T-rex-shaped cliff. Visit Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool carved into the rocky coastline, & marvel at the dramatic natural arch of Broken Bay. Don't forget Crystal Bay, known for its clear waters and vibrant marine life. Also try snorkeling among colorful coral reefs & tropical fish & savor a local lunch before getting driven back.

days.title: Balinese Massage Experience | Visit to Melasti Beach | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire Dance Show
days.desc: Begin your day with a rejuvenating Balinese massage experience, with traditional techniques using essential oils and rhythmic strokes. Later, set out for a scenic coastal tour & visit Melasti Beach, known for its dramatic cliffs and coastal views. Then, enjoy stunning views of the Indian Ocean from Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff edge. As the sun sets, witness the captivating Kecak Dance performance, where rhythmic chants and fire-lit storytelling unfold against a dramatic sunset backdrop.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of your hotel in Seminyak and board your transfer to the airport. Once at the airport, board your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing Bali trip!
